howToRead: Each fix names the vertices of one skinned primitive whose weights leak across limb chains.
Applying it drops the weight on removeBones from those vertices and renormalises the rest;
a vertex in donors had nothing left, and takes the weights listed for it instead.
Every fix here is applied at load. Proposals that were never applied are archived in archive/skinfix-review/.
